Difficulty in Phantom Blade Zero
In this Fextralife video, I want to talk a little bit about the difficulty of Phantom Blade Zero. There's been a lot of discussion around this, particularly since I published my review about the game. I want to give you some further insights into my thoughts about the difficulty of this game. But before I do, first of all, let me just say I'm a huge fan of Phantom Blade Zero.

description:
How to use Whiteshadow - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you how to use the Whiteshadow weapon in Phantom Blade Zero. This is an extremely deadly weapon in the right hands, probably one of the most powerful weapons in the game. And it's also a really interesting weapon because unlike other two-handed weapons in Phantom Blade Zero, this weapon attacks much more rapidly.
